name: HydroGym GPU (JAX/PyTorch)
description: Installs HydroGym GPU venv with JAX-Fluids and HydroGym[maia,jax] extras. Requires python-ml feature.

hydrogymExtras.description: HydroGym extras to install. Includes jaxfluids by default since this feature also installs JAX-Fluids itself (jaxfluidsRepo below) - dropping it from here still leaves JAX-Fluids installed but hydrogym.jaxfluids unimportable (missing pyvista/gitpython/h5py/optax, which live in pyproject.toml's jaxfluids extras group, not jax).
